xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5654: mobile-android CI fails on PRs that touch no mobile code when Robolectric's runtime android-all download hits a network error

plan.title: mobile-android CI fails on PRs that touch no mobile code when Robolectric's runtime android-all download hits a network error
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Robolectric 4.15.1 downloads its ~200 MB android-all-instrumented jar (SDK 35: 15-robolectric-12650502-i7) from Maven Central at test run time through its own MavenArtifactFetcher into ~/.m2, outside Gradle. The mobile-android CI job caches only Gradle, so every run downloads the jar and one transient network error fails the job and the required `test` aggregate check, even on PRs that touch no mobile code (PR #5607, PR #5651 on 2026-11-23).
narratives.Proposal: Run Robolectric offline. A non-transitive Gradle configuration `robolectricRuntime` resolves the android-all jar through Gradle (cached in ~/.gradle locally and by setup-java's Gradle cache in CI), a `fetchRobolectricRuntime` Sync task copies it into app/build/robolectric-runtime, and every Test task depends on that task and passes robolectric.offline=true plus robolectric.dependency.dir. CI gains a separate prefetch step with exactly one retry, and a guard step asserting ~/.m2/repository/org/robolectric was never written. apps/mobile/README.md documents the mechanism and the version coupling. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-5654.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Upgrading Robolectric, changing the pinned SDK 35, or adding Robolectric tests
- Caching ~/.m2 in CI (only as the documented WI-1 fallback)
- Retrying the `Android unit tests` step or adding continue-on-error anywhere
- Changing assembleDebug, the APK upload, the workflow triggers, or other CI jobs
- Path-filtering mobile-android to skip PRs without mobile changes
- Putting the android-all jar on the unit-test classpath (testImplementation/testRuntimeOnly)
- A changelog.d entry (CI-only change)
- Any acceptance step that deletes or moves ~/.m2 or ~/.gradle

autoDecisions.summary: Chose Gradle-managed offline Robolectric (robolectric.offline + robolectric.dependency.dir) over an actions/cache step on ~/.m2.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says to pick the option that also removes the download from local runs if no harder; offline mode does that and Gradle's resolver has its own HTTP retry. Verified in robolectric-4.15.1.jar bytecode that LegacyDependencyResolver reads both properties and LocalDependencyResolver expects <artifactId>-<version>.jar.

autoDecisions.summary: Used a dedicated non-transitive configuration plus a Sync task instead of the issue's literal testRuntimeOnly suggestion.
autoDecisions.rationale: testRuntimeOnly would put the 200 MB framework jar on the unit-test classpath; Robolectric only needs a directory holding the file under its expected name.

autoDecisions.summary: Kept one retry, on a separate prefetch step only.
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue rule 2: a cold Gradle cache still downloads, so one retry stays; scoping it to the fetch step avoids hiding flaky tests.

autoDecisions.summary: Added a CI guard step `test ! -e $HOME/.m2/repository/org/robolectric` after the unit tests.
autoDecisions.rationale: On a fresh runner that directory exists only if Robolectric fell back to online resolution, so it proves the offline properties reached the test JVM; it deletes nothing.
The change alters only CI and the Android test build, not user-facing behavior.

items.title: Resolve Robolectric's android-all jar through Gradle and run Robolectric offline

verify_commands: bun install --frozen-lockfile && npm --prefix apps/mobile run build && npm --prefix apps/mobile run cap:sync -- android
expected_outputs: testDebugUnitTest BUILD SUCCESSFUL with passing TEST-ai.overdeck.app.PushHandlerTest.xml and TEST-ai.overdeck.app.PushNoticeTest.xml

with a one-off uncommitted edit pointing robolectric.dependency.dir at an empty build/robolectric-empty dir, PushNoticeTest fails and the output or JUnit XML contains 'Unable to locate dependency' or 'Path is not a file:'

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly in apps/mobile/android/app/build.gradle: add `def robolectricVersion = '4.15.1'` and `def robolectricAndroidAllVersion = '15-robolectric-12650502-i7'` with the coupling comment above `android {`; add `configurations { robolectricRuntime { transitive = false } }` immediately before `dependencies {`; replace the literal robolectric testImplementation with `"org.robolectric:robolectric:$robolectricVersion"` and add `robolectricRuntime "org.robolectric:android-all-instrumented:$robolectricAndroidAllVersion"`; after the dependencies block register `fetchRobolectricRuntime` (Sync from configurations.robolectricRuntime into layout.buildDirectory.dir('robolectric-runtime')) and configure every Test task with dependsOn plus systemProperty robolectric.offline=true and robolectric.dependency.dir. Local Gradle needs bun install, the web build, cap:sync android and ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Android/Sdk first. Implementation checkpoint: if offline mode cannot be made to work, apply the PRD's documented fallback (actions/cache on ~/.m2/repository/org/robolectric plus a fetch-only `mvn -B dependency:get` step retried once; never retry the test task) and record it in continue.json. This machine already has the jar in ~/.m2, so a plain test pass proves nothing; run the empty-directory negative check from the PRD and never delete or move ~/.m2.

items.title: Given the new wiring, when `./gradlew :app:fetchRobolectricRuntime` runs, then it creates app/build/robolectric-runtime/android-all-instrumented-15-robolectric-12650502-i7.jar
When `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest` runs, then PushHandlerTest and PushNoticeTest each produces a JUnit XML report with zero failures and zero errors

Given robolectric.dependency.dir temporarily points at an empty directory, when PushNoticeTest runs, then it fails and the Gradle output or JUnit XML contains 'Unable to locate dependency' or 'Path is not a file:' (proves offline mode is active)
app/build.gradle contains a robolectricRuntime configuration with transitive = false, and no testImplementation or testRuntimeOnly line contains android-all
Add a one-retry Robolectric prefetch step and an offline guard step to the mobile-android CI job

expected_outputs: step order lists 'Sync Capacitor (Android)', 'Fetch the Robolectric runtime', 'Android unit tests', 'Check Robolectric ran offline', 'Assemble the debug APK'
diff adds only the two new steps and their comments inside the mobile-android job
the PR's mobile-android CI run shows all three Robolectric-related steps succeeding

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2 in .github/workflows/ci.yml, job mobile-android: between `Sync Capacitor (Android)` and `Android unit tests` insert step `Fetch the Robolectric runtime` (working-directory apps/mobile/android, run `./gradlew :app:fetchRobolectricRuntime --no-daemon || ./gradlew :app:fetchRobolectricRuntime --no-daemon`); between `Android unit tests` and `Assemble the debug APK` insert step `Check Robolectric ran offline` running `test ! -e "$HOME/.m2/repository/org/robolectric"`. Keep the PRD's comments. Change nothing else. Workflow edits must be pushed over SSH (gh OAuth token lacks the workflow scope): `git push git@github.com:eltmon/overdeck.git HEAD:feature/pan-5654` if HTTPS push is refused.

items.title: Given a mobile-android CI run, when Capacitor sync finishes, then the job runs `Fetch the Robolectric runtime` before `Android unit tests`, and that step retries `:app:fetchRobolectricRuntime` exactly once via `||`
The `Check Robolectric ran offline` step fails the job when $HOME/.m2/repository/org/robolectric exists after the unit tests
The `Android unit tests` step preserves its original single `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --no-daemon` command with no retry or continue-on-error, and the PR's mobile-android run passes all its steps
Document offline Robolectric and the version coupling in apps/mobile/README.md
